events.t: — Wave 0: Foundation —
Harness online: real WebGL headless Chromium, 120fps, screenshots + console capture.
Wave 0 attempt 1 stopped by account session limit. Salvaged: 6 content bibles (~47k words) + render prototype.
— Wave 0: Foundation (attempt 2) — canon + art direction + engine + vertical slice —
Art direction locked (9 shoot-look-fix rounds): warm toon village meadow, 76 draw calls, 120fps → docs/ART-DIRECTION.md
Canon keeper: docs/CANON.md written (7k words), reconciling the six bibles…
User asked for more sub-agents → opening a parallel wave: music, SFX+mixer, battle rules (no dependency on the engine being built).

Canon pass: docs/CANON.md is the single source of truth; all six bibles reconciled (Bram, Willow, Sera, Barty, Bobble, Pip, Mortmain, Puddlewick, Cobwell Manor, Ambergarde); added DQV beats B11b sabre-cat reunion, Papa's Letter, wagon return, ship, Malgrim.
F1 engine spine verified (32/32 asserts). F2 input, F4 DQ window, F5 save built; F3 art foundation finishing.
P28 SFX first critic round: 62 — gap: sword hits are sub-150Hz thuds that vanish on laptop speakers. Builder fixing.

Integrator: first vertical slice — boots into Puddlewick Vale (meadow map, spring/orbit camera with occlusion, circle collision w/ sliding + corner assist, placeholder Bram, F4 signpost dialogue). scenarios/slice.json passes: 0 errors, ~120 fps, ~130-145k tris, <230 calls.
Vertical slice integrated: boots into Puddlewick Vale, walkable, signpost dialogue. Blind critics (look, feel) judging now.
Critic r1: P14 battle rules 50, P19 growth 45 (difficulty flat then a wall; levels don't matter), P27 music 56 (strings/horns sound like filtered saws), P28 SFX 62→62 (hits lack a transient snap).
★ Owner approved the look & UI ('much prettier than the original — keep it'). Locked as floor: docs/approved/*.png, tag approved-look-v1.

Owner decision: music uses REAL recorded instruments like PS2 (vendored CC0 samples). Wave A stopped & relaunched as A2: P27 rebuilt on samples; P28, P14/P19 continue; + P07/P08 characters & animation, P16 monster models.
— Wave 1: Smooth + Wave B (camera, sky/terrain, props, buildings+Puddlewick, dialogue+NPCs, battle scene, menus+HUD, title) —
Foundation wave complete: slice forge r1 avg 62 → r2 avg 73 (look 74, feel 72). 13 agents.
Session limit hit 23:20 (resets 00:20). Watcher woke every 15 min. 00:20: game verified booting, WIP committed, resuming Wave A2 + smoother/Wave B.

Smoother done (self 77): per-piece seams carved, real Bram + audio wired, docs on canon names. Wave B builds started: camera, sky/terrain, props, buildings+Puddlewick, dialogue+NPCs (then battle, menus+HUD, title).
Orchestrator eyes: church gable renders bright magenta in the P05 building kit (likely missing material) — noted for P05.
P28 r11: hit weight + amb_town loop join + level-up sting; hitCheck/selfTest/uiCheck ok, scenarios/P28.json exits 0 (shots/P28-r11)
Recovered P28 critic r2 verdict (76) from a crashed agent transcript — StructuredOutput JSON parse error lost it. Restarting P28's loop from that gap.

P14/P19 r4: Tactics engine + first-hour rebalance + bosses recalibrated; journey passes on seeds 20040/7/99; demos/P14.html now the meadow stage with P16 monsters, P28 SFX, P27 score, the level-up ceremony and the join question alone on screen
P07/P08 a3: the father-and-son frame rebuilt (demo __DQ.pair(speed,'side'|'line'), __DQ.probe(frames) measures bob/foot slide/staff plant)
P05/P23: Puddlewick is live (register it in src/world/maps/index.js to reach it without a teleport); buildings vanish when P09's occluder-fade hides an object it then fails to ghost
